- TOTAL revenue reached £63.3k TW versus £59.2k LW, a WoW gain of 6.9%.
- TOTAL revenue of £63.3k TW compares with £38.2k LY, a YoY increase of 65.9%.
- TOTAL volume TW was 27,369 units across 1,807 orders.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT led products TW at £2,152.90, a 3.4% share of TOTAL revenue, ahead of WOOD BLACK BOARD ANT WHITE FINISH at £2,057.46 (3.2%) and REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER at £1,991.04 (3.1%).
- The top five products combined held 15.0% of TOTAL revenue TW, with RED HARMONICA IN BOX at £1,731.06 (2.7%) and JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT at £1,554.01 (2.5%).
- SMALL ZINC HEART WALL ORGANISER posted the largest WoW rise at 11,787.1%, followed by WOOD BLACK BOARD ANT WHITE FINISH at 496.6% and RED HARMONICA IN BOX at 320.3%.
- JUMBO BAG ALPHABET fell 79.6% WoW, JUMBO BAG APPLES fell 75.1% WoW, and JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT fell 47.2% WoW.
- PARTY BUNTING recorded a YoY increase of 1,981.0% TW versus LY.
